title: Understanding the Scree Plot
text: The scree plot shows the proportion of variance captured by each principal component. Look for the point where the plot starts to level off.

title: Identifying the Elbow
text: The 'elbow' in the scree plot indicates the number of principal components that capture most of the variance. How many components are before the plot levels off?

title: Counting the Principal Components
text: Count the number of principal components before the plot levels off. This is the intrinsic dimension of the dataset.
